What's New in VoiceInk 2.25

  • ✨ Added Smart Punctuation
  • 🧠 Improved Dictionary Auto Learning
  • ⌨️ Added Direct Typing and Remote Desktop Typing support as a Paste Method
  • ↩️ Restored per-mode Auto Send
  • 🗣️ Added support for Mistral Voxtral 3 transcription models
  • ☁️ Added support for Soniox V6, AssemblyAI Universal 3.6 Pro, and ElevenLabs Scribe V2 Medical
  • ⚙️ Support for custom enhancement model names
  • 📋 Improved context awareness
  • 🔄 Improved recording shortcut recovery
  • 📋 Improved paste reliability and clipboard restoration
  • 🌐 Improved website mode triggers
  • 🌍 Added Japanese localization
  • 🛠️ Minor bug fixes and improvements
